summary: Implemented consent-gated git push enforcement across all 13 plan phases: a net-new PreToolUse push guard and tamper guard, a UserPromptSubmit mint hook minting single-use HMAC-signed grants only from a literal human prompt, the sanctioned wrapper, the identical grant check added to the destructive-action guard, the /please command, a full rule-narrowing and consistency sweep (which caught and fixed a real tag-vs-branch push-classification bug), the orchestrator relay contract with its own documented threat-model section, and five test suites (all additive to existing suites, zero cases altered). Live-fire confirmed from the deployed byte copies; full repository test suite (105/108 passed, 3 pre-existing/unrelated), check-extension-docs.sh, and verify-deploy.sh all green after fixing two self-discovered regressions (an eager-context budget overage and a single-source session-id lint violation).

artifacts.summary: Full implementation summary: what changed, 8 design decisions, plan deviations, verification evidence (including the live-fire transcript and test-suite triage), consistency-sweep results, and named residual risks.
